title: The criteria change has no screen, no operation, no write right in rwb-writeoff and no home for the criteria version
source: Legacy RWB-E6-026 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E6-026); FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.14, A2.14.2, A2.14.3.1, A2.14.3.3 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T3.1, T4, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 feature row FEAT-WOF-14; _work/msr/context/S7.md ownership and connection rows; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-10
section: Functional / criteria change, access and version
description: FEAT-WOF-14 lets the center of excellence change the eligibility or tax criteria as a versioned rule load, but no source gives rwb-writeoff a screen, an operation or a right for the change. FSD A2.14.2 says the analyst opens 'the screen' and the module lists SCR-27 Write-off proposal only, which is the population screen. TSD T-A.1 publishes two operations for the service (POST /write-off-scans and POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision) and neither changes a criterion, while rule authoring, test scenarios, approval and rollback sit in rwb-decision (RWB-P7-E1073). TSD T6.1 gives RW-COE right R on 'Write-off and posting' while FSD A2.14.3.3 makes the center of excellence analyst the primary role of the change, so the write right for a criteria edit is held nowhere in this service. tax_criteria_version, which R-WO-03 and VR-S7-014-1 test, has no table, no column, no parameter key and no named owner: R-WO-03's systems column names 'Reference data' and the 'Finance provision feed' and TSD T3.1 has no version field. The legacy dependency FEAT-CWC-14 has no target story or contract row.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-026 Story, AC1 and AC3 and the Endpoints, Screen and states and Permission checks tables; FSD S7 A1.2 feature row FEAT-WOF-14, A2.14.2 step 1, A2.14.3.1, A2.14.3.3 and Screens (SCR-27 only); TSD S7 T3.1 (DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020, no version field), T4 (R-WO-03, R-WO-04) and T-A.1 (two operations); Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 feature row FEAT-WOF-14 with FEAT-CWC-14; context pack S7 table, REST, event, job and workflow rows; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 patterns of this key (DP03, DP13, DP19 only)
owner_role: Product Owner with the owner of rwb-decision's rule registry and the rwb-writeoff tech lead
proposed: Keep the change where the rule set is governed: rwb-decision authors, tests and approves a version and rwb-writeoff accepts, pins and records it per cut-off, with the version state shown on SCR-27 and no new path in this service; the criteria version stays a package fact with no column. Confirm the screen, the operation, the write right and the home of tax_criteria_version at the wave 4 contract freeze.

title: No published field list for the criteria-version element, and the package read has no name, no call type and no owner document
source: TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3 and T-A.1, T-A.2; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.14; _work/msr/context/S7.md architecture slide 13 connection matrix row S7; legacy RWB-E6-026 sections 7, 11 and 19; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 and R7.2 s12
description: The contract baseline of the criteria-change step fixes a criteria-version element, a run state and a pin, and no source publishes their field list, their required flags or their editions: TSD S7 T-A.2 describes the scan by its purpose, its request name and its response name only, TSD T3.1 carries no version field and T3.2 leaves the list table empty. The consumed package read has no operation name in any source, and its call type is not settled for the contract: the connection matrix row of S7 gives a Temporal line to P7 and no line to P3, so the package is an activity on the rwb-decision queue and the case boundary is a stage outcome, while the matrix also gives S7 REST and listen lines to P1 and P2 that carry no criteria version. The owner of tax_criteria_version and the home of the accepted-version history are unnamed, and the plan's contract-dependency row for this key is None although the step consumes three rows.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 (API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 only), T-A.2 (purpose, request, response, errors, authorization, idempotency and no field list), T3.1 and T3.2; FSD S7 A2.14.3.2 field catalog (write_off columns only, no version field); context pack S7 slide 13 row 'S7 Write-off' with T at P7, T E at P8 and R E at P1 and no cell at P3; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP table and R7.2 section 12
owner_role: Solution architect with the owner of rwb-decision and the rwb-writeoff tech lead
proposed: Publish the criteria-version element and the version state with the owner's payload at the wave 4 contract freeze, declare the package read as a Temporal activity on the rwb-decision queue (or as one REST hop where that owner publishes a contract) and the case boundary as a stage outcome, and record the three consumed rows as class C dependencies of the scan operation.
